# Slow Momentum with Fast Reversion GP changepoint components

Official code for Wood, Roberts and Zohren (2022), [Slow Momentum with Fast Reversion A Trading Strategy Using Deep Learning and Changepoint Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.13727).

Source: https://github.com/kieranjwood/slow-momentum-fast-reversion at commit `b22006066c274cd5953446baf24b99a2726068e4`. Copyright and MIT terms remain in `LICENSE`.

The source implements Gaussian-process changepoint detection, classical strategies and data preparation. The supplementary LSTM implementation is retained in `../author-lstm-cpd/`. This local README describes the components used for the course project; the Python source remains unchanged. Source and local-file hashes are in `UPSTREAM.json`.
